title: Skills and layered agent capabilities
subtitle: Package reusable expertise while preserving policy, permissions, and context efficiency.
goal: Load reusable expertise without loading every instruction at once
intro: A skill packages a method; the runtime and tools still determine what can execute.
terms: A reusable task procedure and resources
flow: Use permitted tools under host policy
case: An agent reviews a drafted answer against its cited evidence.
It loads the review skill instead of every available task manual.
A skill cannot make an unauthorized export permissible.
